name: H-457 Mini Shark

origin.basis: Chaoyang is the bicycle-tire brand of ZC Rubber (Zhongce).

manufacturing.basis: Neither the listing nor the official post states the factory.

positioning: Chaoyang's entry road tire with a shark-skin puncture layer, an upgrade of the original-equipment tires on domestic road bikes.
weight_basis: No weight is given in the listing or the official post.

availability.note: Sold by mainland Taobao shops; no official-store listing was read for this model.

price_observations.conditions: Shop price on 2026-11-01 for the black non-folding 700x25C and 700x28C options; the listing does not say one tire or a pair.
Shop price on 2026-11-01 for the 700x25C skin-wall option; one tire or a pair not stated.

caveats: Weights, pressure limits and the casing of each version are not published in the listing.
No owner report or wet-road evidence was found; the official post is a maker claim.
Chaoyang places it for daily training and leisure, below the H-496 Falcon.

image.shown: Chaoyang's launch poster for the H-457 Mini Shark, with the tire and its 700x25C and 28C weights for the 60 and 30 TPI versions.
image.alt: Chaoyang Mini Shark H-457 poster showing the road tire and its size and weight table

rights.usage_note: A photo from a public Xiaohongshu post, shown from Xiaohongshu with a link to the original post; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components catalogues and Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test index. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this model; questions, seller and maker replies, unmounted impressions and reports about other models were left out.
